MOD = 998244353

# Precompute Stirling numbers of the second kind
stirling = [[0] * 5001 for _ in range(5001)]
stirling[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, 5001):
    for j in range(1, 5001):
        stirling[i][j] = (stirling[i - 1][j - 1] + j * stirling[i - 1][j]) % MOD

def mod_inverse(x, p):
    return power(x, p - 2, p)

def power(base, exp, p):
    res = 1
    base %= p
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % p
        base = (base * base) % p
        exp >>= 1
    return res

# Read input
input_line = input()
tokens = input_line.split()
n = int(tokens[0])
m = int(tokens[1])
k = int(tokens[2])

inv_m = mod_inverse(m, MOD)
product = 1
total = 0
prob = 1

for i in range(k, 0, -1):
    product = (product * (n - (k - i))) % MOD
    prob = (prob * inv_m) % MOD
    total = (total + ((product * prob) % MOD) * stirling[k][k - i + 1]) % MOD

print(total)
